column.name: name
column.description: Human-readable name for the import job.

column.name: description
column.description: Optional description of the import job.

column.name: reference
column.description: Unique human-readable reference for the import job.

column.name: status
column.description: Current status: receiving, pending, processing, done, imported_with_errors, failed. A run only moves receiving to pending, pending to processing, and processing to done, imported_with_errors or failed.

column.name: number_of_processed_lines
column.description: Total number of CSV rows attempted.

column.name: number_of_successfully_processed_lines
column.description: Number of successfully processed CSV rows.

column.name: number_of_failed_lines
column.description: Number of CSV rows that failed processing.

column.name: number_of_processed_bytes
column.description: Number of bytes of the import file read so far, or null when the file handle cannot report its position.

column.name: file_info
column.description: JSON-encoded file metadata: fileSystemName, storedPath, originalFileName, contentType, size.

column.name: claimed_by
column.description: Identifier of the worker that holds the processing lease.

column.name: lease_expires_at
column.description: Timestamp after which another worker may reclaim the processing run.

column.name: attempt_count
column.description: Number of times a worker has claimed the run.

column.name: csv_row_number
column.description: The CSV row number that caused the error.

column.name: error_message
column.description: Error message describing what went wrong.
